Andy Castillo uses the internet to call and text female realtors in 20 different states; wielding their social media against them, he makes the women believe he's lurking nearby, adding to their terror.

title: Devil in the Web

title: Devil in the Web
description:

CeCe bonds with a man she meets on a dating app, and she happily obliges when he asks her for money for his business, but she becomes yet another victim of a romance scam.

title: Devil in the Web
description:

Online cult leader Sherry Shriner reaches her followers through YouTube videos and keeps them in line via her Facebook page; when a group member dies in a tragic shooting, attention turns to Sherry and the control she wields over her followers.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E01 — People You May Know
Single mother Lorianna Parker meets good-looking Corey Davis online, and she is filled with hope as their friendship blossoms, but when she meets him in the flesh, her dream date turns into a living nightmare.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E07 — Playing Doctor
Twenty-four-year-old Jessika Rovell falls for Jeffrey Marsalis' charm and good looks but when she discovers his secret online life as Dr. Jeff, she realizes she's been dating a monster who stalks dating sites.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E06 — Love You to Death
Seventeen-year-old adoptee Chelsea Schobert feels out of place at home, then she finds acceptance with Shawn whom she meets online, but as their relationship develops, the whole family is drawn into a devastating series of events.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E08 — Crime Scene Selfie
Twenty-three-year-old Amanda Taylor shares her entire life on the Internet, then a tragedy takes place, and her posts take a dark turn.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E01 — The Springfield Three
On June 6, 1992, Suzie Streeter and Stacy McCall attend parties celebrating their high school graduation; by morning, the teenagers have gone missing, along with Suzie's mother, Sherrill Levitt; the case leads police on a nationwide search.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E11 — Suburban Secrets
After doting mother Cheryl Coker vanishes from Riverside, Ohio, numerous searches turn up nothing; as police take a closer look at the case, they uncover some disturbing information.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E03 — Without a Trace
In San Francisco, Kevin Collins, 10, disappears on his way home, galvanizing the residents to find him; with few leads to go on, Kevin's case sheds light on hundreds of other children who have vanished without a trace in the United States.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

Right before Thanksgiving, two masked gunmen reportedly invade a couple's home and kill the husband; with few leads, police use ballistics, forensics and neighborhood gossip to solve this cold-blooded murder.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

In 1988, a young woman is found murdered in her Modesto, Calif., home, leading police to investigate the strife and infidelity in her marriage; a surprising witness eventually comes forward.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E07 — Law & Murder
A double murder involving the family of a federal judge prompts an investigation of epic proportions by the FBI, U.S. Marshals and Chicago Police Department; at the end of the trail, law enforcement personnel learn the death count may climb higher.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

Jennifer Brown, vanishes from her Limerick home and detectives race against the clock to find her. With her eight-year-old son asking where his mother is, investigators must confront a web of lies woven by the people she trusts the most.

Arkansas police stop a knifeman enraged over a midnight pot roast; in Delray Beach, Fla., officers must rescue two children teetering on a ledge with their mother who is high on drugs; in Utah, a trespasser attacks an officer with his own baton.

title: Body Cam
description:

title: Body Cam
description:

An armed suspect fires at police before embarking on a pursuit; a man locks himself in his garage, but it catches fire, and police don't know if they're on a rescue mission or victims of an ambush.

title: See No Evil
description:

In Groton, Vermont, a young man with a developmental disability leaves work and is never seen again; with no leads in sight, investigators must rely on surveillance footage to piece together the truth behind Christopher Gray's disappearance.

title: See No Evil
description:
S10 E01 — Ticket to Murder
In Dalton, Ga., someone stabs convenience store clerk Dahyabhai Kalidas Chaudhari to death at his job; police turn to security footage for answers and discover a surprise revelation about the killer's identity that blows the case wide open.

title: See No Evil
description:
S10 E08 — Comply or Die
In North Carolina, Stephanie Powell-Anderson's convenience store shift ends in bloodshed, as part of a larger pattern of violence plaguing the area; with the assailant growing bolder by the day, the heat is on to make an arrest before he kills again.

title: See No Evil
description:

The police lack leads after single mom Laura Ackerson leaves for work one morning and never returns, so they turn to surveillance cameras to try to locate her and unearth sinister footage.

Michelle Mockbee arrives at work early in order to get ahead on payroll, and she is murdered outside her office less than an hour later; detectives follow the surveillance footage to a closet full of dirty secrets.
